text:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: release/2.4.0 -> canary A (ROLL-9876). Change window open. Watching health checks and perf.
chris: FYI seeing embed-service p95 latency jump after canary 3 -> 780ms, p50 ~210ms. Baseline p95 ~320ms.
lisa: hmm, are these across regions or just us-east-1?
chris: just us-east-1 so far. Canary subset is 5% traffic there.
maya: tagging ops-oncall @ops-oncall — do we want to abort canary or let it run to gather more traces?
ops-oncall: looking at tracing, there's a tight GC pattern on a subset of pods and a rollout of quantized-model variant on the canary. Could be kernel/runtime mismatch. Recommend abort and pin to previous model while we investigate. :warning:
ben: agree with abort + pin. If we keep rolling and it becomes global, rollback will be much harder.
release-coordinator: decision call: abort canary and pin to model@v2.3.7. Who's going to execute?
lisa: I'll take the abort and pin. Running commands in 1m.
chris: pre-checks: traffic reroute policy, remove canary tags and ensure fallback meshes have capacity.
lisa: running:```
# abort canary
deployctl rollout abort --id ROLL-9876 --target canary-A
# pin previous model
deployctl model pin --service embed-service --version v2.3.7 --reason "canary perf regression"```
deploy-bot: Received abort command for ROLL-9876 from lisa at 2105006845. Aborting canary.
deploy-bot: Model pin applied: embed-service -> v2.3.7 by lisa. Audit id: AUD-44512.
ops-oncall: traffic already routing to stable pool, pod counts scaled up to absorb; latency trending back to baseline.
chris: can we capture the failing canary pods for postmortem? logs + heap/profile snapshot?
maya: yes — saved heapdump and strace from the failing instance, uploaded to https://redwood.internal/artifacts/ROLL-9876/canary-dump.tar.gz
release-coordinator: created a short outbrief and attached runbook links: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/backout-procedures and https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-pin-playbook
ben: next steps: 1) escalate to runtime team with trace + dump, 2) open a regression eval against v2.4.0 on smaller prompt set, 3) schedule a canary retry with instrumentation flags.
lisa: noted. I'll mark the release status: CANARY_ABORTED, PINNED -> v2.3.7, block re-roll until runtime triage.
release-coordinator: added blocker, notifying PM and SRE leads. Quick checklist for post-abort: - incident short writeup - attach dumps & traces - preserve canary nodes (if possible) - create reproducible eval. Runbook we followed: "Model rollout backout" (see link above).
chris: thanks team. If anyone needs the exact commands or audit ids: AUD-44512, ROLL-9876.
ops-oncall: leaving a small note in incidents channel and will keep monitoring for 30m. :white_check_mark:
release-coordinator: filing a short retro doc and scheduling a sync with runtime next week. Closing thread.
